_what_this_is: Per-brand affiliate deep-link templates. build_catalog.py rewrites every outbound product URL for a brand listed here through that brand's own affiliate program, which pays 3-10x the Sovrn catch-all. The literal token {url} is replaced with the percent-encoded destination. Brand keys match case- and spacing-insensitively.
_how_to_add_one: 1. Sign up for the brand's program (see _verified_programs below for the ones we already found). 2. The network gives you a deep-link / tracking URL containing YOUR publisher id. 3. Replace the destination part of it with the literal token {url}. 4. Add it here as "Brand Name": "<template>". 5. Commit. The next catalog build routes that brand through it. Run the three test_*.py fixture scripts before pushing - they are CI gates.
_is_this_safe_to_commit: Yes, by construction. An affiliate template is embedded in every outbound URL the app produces, so anyone can read it off a single product tap. It is an identifier, not a credential - it cannot spend money or read an account. If a network ever issues one containing something genuinely secret, put THAT one in the BRAND_AFFILIATE_TEMPLATES Actions secret instead, which overrides this file.
